text: What is the benefit of associating with the virtuous? What is the misery of associating with the ignorant? What is the loss of falling from one’s station? What is the skill in the essence of dharma? Who is the hero who has conquered the senses? Who is the most beloved one who is devoted? What is wealth? What is knowledge? What is happiness? What is going on a journey? What is kingship? What is the fruit of command?
